facts.fact: The director of the unique identifier and civil-status document security said VENEEM, used at health facilities and main centres to declare and register events and print the act on site, is in a pilot in three communes (Ouagadougou arrondissement 3, Komsilga), with all Ouagadougou arrondissements, Bobo-Dioulasso and Komsilga to have it before the end of 2024.
